page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by AMD EPYC 9T34 processors. The system features 256 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, paired with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The instance integrates four NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 160 Gbps. This server does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached storage options.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge offers high resource density by combining massive compute capabilities with specialized GPU accelerators on a single node. The lack of local storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-intensive workloads. However, the high-speed 160 Gbps network baseline helps mitigate external storage latency.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring parallel processing and high-performance computing. Suitable applications include machine learning inference, large-scale data science jobs, distributed database hosting, and complex graphics rendering pipelines.
